description: Break-even throughput, as each GPU's and each model's page shows it: the tokens per second one GPU must sell at a model's list price (3 input : 1 output) to cover the GPU's rental price today. Give a GPU for every model on it, a model for every GPU, or a company for its models; give a throughput for what the gross margin calculator on a model's page shows: the revenue per GPU-hour and the gross margin.

gpu.description: One GPU; omit for all listed.

model.description: A model's name or page id (e.g. "Claude Opus 5.5"); omit for every model.

throughput_tokens_per_second.description: Tokens per second one GPU generates (input and output, 3 to 1).

name: get_workload_cost

breakeven_tokens_per_second.description: Tokens per second one GPU must sell at the list price to cover its rental

gross_margin_pct.description: At the given throughput, as the gross margin calculator

list_price.description: The model's list price, 3 input : 1 output, USD per 1M tokens

rental_price.description: The GPU's index, USD per GPU-hour

revenue_per_gpu_hour.description: At the given throughput, as the gross margin calculator

title: Break-even throughput and gross margin
